sources.title: The Inventions, Researches and Writings of Nikola Tesla
sources.creator: Thomas Commerford Martin
sources.notes: Tesla-approved 1894 compilation; includes the 1891, 1892, and 1893 lectures and early patent explanations.

sources.title: My Inventions
sources.creator: Nikola Tesla
sources.notes: Originally serialized in Electrical Experimenter. Treat autobiographical recollections as primary testimony, not independent verification.

sources.title: The Problem of Increasing Human Energy
sources.creator: Nikola Tesla
sources.notes: Century Magazine, pages 175–211. Prefer the periodical page images when quoting.

sources.title: Nikola Tesla U.S. patents
sources.creator: Nikola Tesla; United States Patent Office
sources.notes: Catalog patents individually by publication number. Google Patents is convenient; preserve links to official scans or records where available.

sources.title: Nikola Tesla papers
sources.creator: Nikola Tesla and associated patent firms
sources.notes: Smithsonian Libraries marks this digitized collection CC0.

sources.title: Nikola Tesla correspondence, 1890–1934
sources.creator: Nikola Tesla
sources.notes: Seven microfilm reels, arranged by correspondent; not a downloadable full-text collection.

sources.title: FBI records concerning Nikola Tesla
sources.creator: Federal Bureau of Investigation
sources.notes: Evidence about government handling of Tesla's effects and later inquiries, not proof that technical claims within the files are true.

sources.title: Kenneth M. Swezey Papers
sources.creator: Kenneth M. Swezey
sources.notes: 26 boxes; includes Tesla correspondence, patents, articles, photographs, and Swezey research notes. Mostly requires in-person research.

sources.title: The patents of Nikola Tesla
sources.creator: Snežana Šarboh
sources.notes: World Patent Information 32 (2010), 335–339. Reports 112 U.S. patents and 284 patents across 27 countries; use its appendices to build the definitive patent table.

sources.title: Towards a definitive catalogue of the patents of Nikola Tesla
sources.creator: Vladimir Jelenković
sources.notes: World Patent Information 32 (2010), 147–149. Explains the catalog's research history and changing counts.

sources.title: Nikola Tesla: On His Work with Alternating Currents
sources.creator: Leland I. Anderson, editor
sources.notes: Edited transcript of Tesla's 1916 pre-hearing interview; verify quotations against transcript pages.
